subject: PO alignment + invoice windows: Q3 sprint checklist
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@NimbusHealth.com>, lauren.bishop@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: PO alignment + invoice windows: Q3 sprint checklist

Team / Aisha —

Following up from the pipeline hygiene call: we need to lock the PO arrival and invoice window for the Q3 bookings tied to the RW-98765 deal. Key asks below so finance can commit the booking for July recognition: 

- PO must be fully executed and received by Redwood (procurement@nimbushealth.com or uploaded to the DocuSign link) by EOD July 7 to meet the July 31 revenue recognition cutoff.
- If PO arrives after July 7, the booking will migrate to the August recognition batch (this impacts Q3 ARR and sales commit).
- Please confirm billing code (Nimbus GL: 54-312) and whether Nimbus will request net-30 or net-60 terms — net-60 will push recognition later.

I've attached our PO template and a short checklist (redwood-po-checklist.xlsx) with the invoice window mapping and the minimal fields our billing team requires. For visibility, putting Lauren and Ben on thread to coordinate commit review and pipeline flagging.

Proposed quick steps:
1) Aisha: confirm procurement timeline and whether your finance team can issue PO by 7/7.
2) Ben: if PO slips, update the opportunity status to "Deferred recognition" and flag the commit review doc.
3) Lauren: please schedule the internal commit review (we should meet 7/06 if possible).

Attachments: Nimbus_PO_template_v2.pdf (fillable), redwood-po-checklist.xlsx

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Senior Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Cc: procurement@nimbushealth.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.com

Hi Connor —

Thanks for the clear list. Procurement is already moving on this. Quick answers: 
- We expect procurement to issue the PO and sign the DocuSign packet by COB July 5. I will personally escalate to make sure we hit that window.
- Nimbus prefers net-30; we will confirm if there's any exception for this contract (I don't expect net-60).
- Billing code confirmed: 54-312.

I will upload the signed PO to the DocuSign link once complete and copy procurement@nimbushealth.com. If anything changes, I will let you know immediately.

Thanks — Aisha
Aisha Rahman
Head of Partnerships, Nimbus Health
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>

Connor / Ben —

Thanks Aisha — that timeline (PO by 7/5) gives us a small buffer. Two operational clarifications for finance recognition: 

- The gating rule we apply: PO received + correct billing code + signed SOW before the recognition cutoff (July 7 EOD) => include in July recognition. Missing any piece pushes to August.
- If procurement delivers a PO that references a future start date (e.g., 8/1), we will treat revenue start as the contract start date; please double-check the PO effective date field.

I'll set the internal commit review for 2028-07-06 at 16:00 UTC / 09:00 PT and send an invite to Connor and Ben. Ben, please bring the opportunity commit doc (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-98765) — we'll record the decision and the fallback path so sales and finance have the same view.

Cheers,
Lauren Bishop
Finance Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Great — appreciate the quick turnaround, Aisha. We'll proceed with the schedule below: 

- July 5: Aisha / procurement to send signed PO and upload to DocuSign link.
- July 6, 09:00 PT: internal commit review (Lauren, Ben, Connor). We'll confirm the recognition decision live and lock the booking if PO is present.
- July 7 EOD: final cutoff to include in July recognition run.

If procurement uploads before July 5, please ping me and I'll ask finance to do a pre-check to avoid any surprises. Otherwise we'll default to the fallback plan Lauren described.

DocuSign upload link: https://app.docusign.com/docu-sign/xyz-approve

Connor
